newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran to sign dam contract next week.
newsitem.headline: Ekran to sign dam contract next week.

text.p: Ekran Bhd, the main contractor of the controversial $5.5 billion Bakun hydro-electric dam, will sign the construction pact for the project next week, The Star newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Quoting Ekran executive chairman Ting Pek Khiing, the daily said the contract with a consortium led by ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG and Brazil's CPBO will be inked next Wednesday, a delay from the end of last month.

"The signing of the EPC (engineering procurement construction) will complete the documentation for the (Bakun dam stock) listing exercise. The listing is scheduled for year-end," Ting was quoted as saying.

Ting also said he expected the dam, which would be located in the Borneo island state of Sarawak, to be profitable in its first year of full operations, bringing in 8 million ringgit in income per day.
Bakun has the capacity to generate 2,400 MW of power. Ekran had previously announced the proposed stock listing of Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp Bhd's four billion shares at 1.80 ringgit a piece.
